parsed_json.up: Select compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then filter compound_records where doc_id corresponds to document CHEMBL1125208. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return molecule_chembl_id, pref_name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
